post.description: Create a new account and start the email verification process for the user.
Authenticate a user with their credentials and return access and refresh tokens for the session. The username field accepts either the registered email address or the personal code.
Confirm a user's email address using the verification token sent to them by email.
Send a new email verification link to the user so they can verify their account.
Send password reset instructions to the user's email if the account exists and is verified.
Set a new password using a valid password reset token received by email.
Change the authenticated user's password and invalidate existing sessions for security.

get.description: Show all active login sessions for the current user, including the current device and device details such as browser, OS, and IP address.

delete.description: Revoke every active session except the one currently being used by the caller. Useful for security when you want to keep the current device signed in.
Revoke a single session/device by its session ID. This signs out that device while leaving other active sessions intact.
Sign the user out from every active device and session. The user will need to log in again on all devices.

post.description: Revoke the current session associated with the access token so the current device is signed out.
Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access token and rotated refresh token.

milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.description: Exactly one entry per job milestone

eta_minutes.title: Eta Minutes
eta_minutes.description: Estimated minutes to complete this milestone

BidMilestoneInput.title: BidMilestoneInput
BidMilestoneInput.description:
The provider's plan for one job milestone (day).

``arrival_time`` is a local "HH:MM" that must be one of that
milestone's ``arrival_options`` (inside a window the client
booked, on the 30-minute grid).

BidProviderSummary.title: BidProviderSummary
BidProviderSummary.description:
The provider-facing card shown alongside a bid: name, photo,
rating and badge tier.

BidUpdate.title: BidUpdate
BidUpdate.description:
Any field may be omitted. ``milestones``, when sent, replaces the
whole per-day plan (one entry per job milestone). Updating a bid
removes it from the client's favourites.

BookingType.title: BookingType
BookingType.description:
Chosen by the client immediately after "Book a Service", before
the description form opens, and fixed for the life of the job.

ONE_TIME  -> a single occurrence (one milestone).
MULTI_DAY -> up to JobRequest.MAX_MILESTONES occurrences within
             one week, each tracked as its own JobMilestone.

CancellationQuoteResponse.title: CancellationQuoteResponse
CancellationQuoteResponse.description:
charge_type: NONE | CANCELLATION_FEE (before work starts) |
AFTER_START_PENALTY (5% of the held amount or 5 EUR, whichever is
higher; the rest is refunded manually by support). The charge goes
to the provider's wallet, on hold for 48h.

FeedbackContext.title: FeedbackContext
FeedbackContext.description:
Where a predefined option (FeedbackOption) is offered. Admins manage
the list per context.

InstallmentPayRequest.title: InstallmentPayRequest
InstallmentPayRequest.description:
``amount`` defaults to the next unpaid installment's remaining
balance. A client may pay more than that (up to what's still owed
on the invoice overall) — the surplus rolls onto the following
installment(s) instead of being rejected.

JobActionResponse.title: JobActionResponse
JobActionResponse.description:
Generic envelope for job actions (restart timer, convert to
regular, cancel, ...) that returns a short message alongside the
updated job.

JobBidsResponse.title: JobBidsResponse
JobBidsResponse.description:
Bids for a job, split the way the client app presents them: the
top 3 scores as "Recommended SkillBuddies", the rest behind
"View All Offers". ``favourites`` is the client's shortlist (those
bids also still appear in recommended/other_offers).

JobDetailsRequest.title: JobDetailsRequest
JobDetailsRequest.description:
Body for IN_PROGRESS actions that require an explanation: decline,
pause, or reporting a blocker.

JobMilestoneCreate.title: JobMilestoneCreate
JobMilestoneCreate.description:
One booked day: a local date (settings.APP_TIMEZONE), the arrival
windows the client is available in (TimeSlot codes, e.g.
["MORNING", "EVENING"]), and the expected work duration.

JobMilestoneUpdate.title: JobMilestoneUpdate
JobMilestoneUpdate.description:
PATCH /jobs/{job_id}/milestones/{milestone_id}: only the fields
sent are changed. (PUT takes a full JobMilestoneCreate instead.)

JobReviewCreate.title: JobReviewCreate
JobReviewCreate.description:
POST /jobs/{job_id}/reviews, once per side after the job is CLOSED.
Options come from GET /feedback/options?context=CLIENT_REVIEW (client)
or PROVIDER_REVIEW (provider). Photos are added afterwards with
POST /reviews/{id}/attachments.

JobReviewsResponse.title: JobReviewsResponse
JobReviewsResponse.description:
Both sides of one job. ``their_review`` stays null until it is
published (blind until both reviewed or the reveal window ends).

JobUpdate.title: JobUpdate
JobUpdate.description:
PATCH /jobs/{job_id}. Address is out of scope here - manage it
through the dedicated /jobs/{job_id}/address endpoints instead.

``milestones``, when sent, replaces the whole schedule (same shape
and rules as on create). Doing so auto-rejects every pending bid
on the job, and their providers are notified to bid again.

MediaFeedbackType.title: MediaFeedbackType
MediaFeedbackType.description:
The feedback a photo was added with. Only COMPLETED photos (the
review of a job that closed successfully) may ever be public; the
others are always private and can't be made public.

MediaItemUpdate.title: MediaItemUpdate
MediaItemUpdate.description:
PATCH /media-gallery/{id}, on your own photos. ``is_public`` only for
a client's COMPLETED photos.

MessageResponse.title: MessageResponse
MessageResponse.description:
Generic success response.

Used for:
- logout
- password changed
- profile updated
- etc.

MilestoneFeedbackCreate.title: MilestoneFeedbackCreate
MilestoneFeedbackCreate.description:
Body of POST .../milestones/{id}/decline and .../dispute:
predefined options (GET /feedback/options?context=MILESTONE_DENIAL |
DISPUTE_BY_CLIENT | DISPUTE_BY_PROVIDER) and a required written
message. Dispute images are added afterwards with
POST /milestone-feedback/{id}/attachments.

ProfileReviewsResponse.title: ProfileReviewsResponse
ProfileReviewsResponse.description: Published reviews a provider or client received.

ReviewStatus.title: ReviewStatus
ReviewStatus.description:
SUBMITTED -> PUBLISHED once both sides have reviewed, or when the
reveal window (REVIEW_REVEAL_DAYS after the job closed) ends -
neither side sees the other's review first. HIDDEN: removed by an
admin (abusive); no longer counts towards the rating.

RevisionRequestCreate.title: RevisionRequestCreate
RevisionRequestCreate.description:
A task update / extension on one milestone: extra time, the
milestone's new total price (VAT incl., never lower than now) and
what changes in scope.

SelectedOption.title: SelectedOption
SelectedOption.description: Snapshot of a ticked option, as stored on the feedback.

TimeSlotResponse.title: TimeSlotResponse
TimeSlotResponse.description:
A bookable arrival window. ``arrival_options`` are the 30-minute
arrival times a provider can pick inside it (end excluded).
